projectDescription: A Paper Minecraft plugin that automatically captures player inventory snapshots on death and routes staff-reviewed restore requests through a Discord approval workflow.
keyFeatures: Automatic death snapshot capture — inventory, armor, offhand, XP, and ender chest saved on every death
Discord approval workflow — rollback requests are sent to a configurable Discord channel for staff review
Granular restore types — restore full inventory, armor only, weapons only, XP only, ender chest, or any combination
Queued delivery — approve restores for offline players; items are delivered automatically when they log in
In-game staff GUI — paginated snapshot browser with filter and search support
Audit log with webhook export — every action (request, approve, deny, cancel, reopen, unlock) is logged
Dual database support — SQLite for single-server setups, MySQL for networks
Configurable retention policies — auto-purge old snapshots and audit entries
Combat logout protection — optionally capture snapshots when players disconnect during combat
Multi-language support — messages configurable via lang files
Backup before restore — optionally creates a safety backup of current inventory before applying a rollback
Automatic request timeout — pending requests expire after a configurable window to prevent player lockout
publicApiSurface: /invrollback <player> [page] [filter] [query] — open snapshot browser GUI
/invrollback cancel <deathId> <reason> — cancel a pending request
/invrollback reopen <deathId> — reopen a denied request
/invrollback unlock <deathId> — unlock a restored death entry
/invrollback info <player> — show snapshot statistics for a player
/invrollback history <player> [filter] [query] — list recent snapshots in chat
/invrollback logs <player> — show recent audit log entries
/invrollback export <yml|json> [player] — export audit log to file
/invrollback reload — reload config and restart Discord bot
rollback.view — permission to open the snapshot browser GUI
rollback.request — permission for players to submit restore requests
rollback.info — permission to view stats and history
rollback.logs — permission to view audit logs
rollback.manage.cancel — permission to cancel requests
rollback.manage.reopen — permission to reopen denied requests
rollback.manage.unlock — permission to unlock restored entries
rollback.export — permission to export audit logs
rollback.reload — permission to reload the plugin
rollback.admin.all — grants all permissions
RollbackType: FULL, INVENTORY, ARMOR, OFFHAND, XP, ENDER_CHEST
CustomRestoreType: SWORD, PICKAXE, AXE, SHOVEL, HELMET, CHESTPLATE, LEGGINGS, BOOTS, OFFHAND
SnapshotState: OPEN, PENDING, QUEUED, RESTORED, DENIED
SnapshotFilter: all, open, pending, queued, restored, denied

Config: database.type (SQLITE|MYSQL), discord.bot-token, discord.log-channel-id, discord.admin-role-ids, discord.require-admin-role, discord.audit-webhook-url, storage.max-snapshots-per-player, storage.max-snapshot-age-days, requests.timeout-minutes, requests.max-pending-per-player, protections.create-backup-before-restore, protections.save-combat-logout-snapshots, server.name, lang
